$comment: Byte budgets per tier (kit:validate). Started 2026-10-14 from the maximum over the 42 templates + ~10% (rounded up to a whole KiB). css = compiled stylesheet; html = the preview index.html (inline CSS, what a site serves); images = local assets of one page (total and largest file); js = gzip of the Lattiz Motion runtime (Pro only; Básico ships no JS). Over budget is WARN; --strict-budget and spec builds of a new template FAIL. Raise a number only with a written reason. images.hero = the hero photo (the LCP image on every template): 120 KiB is the A2 LCP policy for new work (spec builds encode it at most 1200 px wide, q72), not today's maximum; existing heavier heroes only warn.
